cohort: Live births in Jamaica between July and September 2011 (87.5% of all births)
finding: Neonatal mortality rate was 14.9/1000 live births, with maternal age <15 years, decreasing birth weight, prematurity, male gender, multiple gestation, and Cesarean birth being associated with increased risk.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth was associated with increased risk of neonatal mortality.
